target: game.dll debug mode — enable verbose debug logging from startup

patches.name: debug_flag_startup
patches.description: Redirect first call in PlayGame (sub_4474C0) to code cave that sets verbose_debug=2. Enables built-in debug logging from startup.

patches.name: debug_flag_cave
patches.description: Code cave in CC padding: sets dword_6BF810=2 (verbose debug) then jumps to original function sub_4986F0.

patches.name: debug_off_nop
patches.description: NOP out the /debug off command so debug mode can't be accidentally disabled.
patches.note: NOP the 'mov dword_6BF810, ebx' in debug off handler
